topic.title: Paid $1 a year: how the richest pay almost no income tax

title: Paid one dollar a year. So how is he this rich? 💸
description:
Mark Zuckerberg's base salary is one dollar. The twenty-five richest Americans' wealth grew by hundreds of billions in five years, and their true tax rate was a few percent. Here's how owning beats earning.
Data: Fortune, ProPublica.
An animated story; the characters are not advisers.
Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
